candidate_responsibility: Select and apply an appropriate prioritization method, score opportunities, and preserve the assumptions behind ranking.

dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.
Known limitations, failure modes, and unsupported assumptions.

fusion_rules.rule: Select and apply an appropriate prioritization method, score opportunities, and preserve the assumptions behind ranking.
Accept only: Validated problems, opportunities, evidence strength, constraints, and decision criteria.
Produce only: A ranked opportunity set, selected framework, scores, rationale, and uncertainty.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.
Preserve named formula variants. Every score must record framework name, exact formula, variable definitions, assumptions, and selected or custom variant.
Produce evidence-backed recommendations and unknowns; GO, PIVOT, KILL, prioritization adoption, roadmap commitment, and build approval remain human decisions.

input_boundary: Validated problems, opportunities, evidence strength, constraints, and decision criteria.
output_boundary: A ranked opportunity set, selected framework, scores, rationale, and uncertainty.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 以 problems/opportunities 而非 customer-designed features 为排序对象。; Opportunity Score 面向 customer problems，以每项 need 的 Importance 和 Satisfaction 调查值为输入。; 定义 current value、opportunity score 和 customer value created 三个相关计算。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 该原则不替代问题发现、方案设计或最终决策授权。; 两项输入必须归一化到 0–1；来源未定义 survey 设计、样本或聚合方法。; S1/S2 分别是前后 satisfaction；公式只在输入量表与 population 口径一致时可比较。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 15 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (method=12, rule=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: Opportunity Score 面向 customer problems，以每项 need 的 Importance 和 Satisfaction 调查值为输入。; 定义 current value、opportunity score 和 customer value created 三个相关计算。; ICE 用 Opportunity Score × affected customers 表示 Impact，再乘 1–10 Confidence 与 1–10 Ease 排 initiatives/ideas。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 两项输入必须归一化到 0–1；来源未定义 survey 设计、样本或聚合方法。; S1/S2 分别是前后 satisfaction；公式只在输入量表与 population 口径一致时可比较。; Confidence/Ease 需校准；Ease 越高分越高，不能替换成同向 Effort；customer count 需明确时间窗与去重口径。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 12 source-grounded atom(s) for method (method=12); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 排序对象是可陈述的 problem/opportunity，不把 customer solution request 直接当作已验证问题。; 解释与公式一致，图表标明轴方向，并把输出保留为 opportunity 而非 feature commitment。; 输出只表达 expectation category 与证据，不生成冒充优先级的 Kano 排名。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 该原则不替代问题发现、方案设计或最终决策授权。; upper-left 依赖坐标轴方向；该结果排序 customer problems，不自动决定 solution。; 来源明确 Kano 不用于 prioritizing；未提供分类调研或计算流程。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 3 source-grounded atom(s) for gates-and-validation (rule=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 在形成候选 initiatives 后选择与决策场景匹配的 prioritization framework，输出推荐框架。; 由 PM、engineering lead 和 product leadership 使用已选框架为 epics 打分并形成 ranked backlog。
